text: For the New Year, I stopped by Chiang Mai and tried Hifu to lift and tighten my face to look more handsome. I looked for a clinic that offered this service on Facebook and came across an advertisement for Club Class Clinic. When I went to use the service, I was very surprised because they had a lot of medical equipment and there was also a doctor who was stationed at Maharaj who was at the clinic. I felt sorry that I didn't live in Chiang Mai. When I visit Chiang Mai, I will do it again because in Bangkok, the starting price is 5-6 thousand. I highly recommend this very good clinic.

Today I went to get my monthly vitamin supplements at a clinic my friend recommended, Club Class Clinic. The price is 400 baht per month, which is very cheap. If you need to take care of your health, you need to find a clinic you can trust. You don't need to take supplements, so you can get more vitamin D. Plus, they provide free snacks, fruit, and drinks. I highly recommend Club Class Clinic.
